sourceTitle: Equipment on site and planned maintenance
observedAudience: Owners and office staff who schedule, dispatch and record field jobs. No developer knowledge is needed.
observedLearningOutcomes: Record equipment at a site as an asset, including parent and child items.
Set a recurring maintenance plan, giving it a repeat interval and a generation window.
Explain why a plan must be checked after an asset is replaced.
note: Source evidence only. Requires a curriculum owner to identify an authoritative course, verify reuse and approve a separate lesson revision; this record does not publish or modify the source.
